item.title: Task Force Admiral Vol.1: American Carrier Battles is now available via Steam EA
item.description: "MicroProse and DryDock Dreams Games are today very excited to announce that Task Force Admiral Vol.1: American Carrier Battles is now available via Steam EA." - MicroProse and DryDock Dreams Games.

item.title: Dont Stop, Girlypop! is Now Available - Launch Trailer
item.description: The unique Y2K arena movement shooter Don't Stop, Girlypop! is now available on Steam, and the developers have released a new Launch Trailer.

item.title: Villion: Code debut trailer, details, and screenshots
item.description: Compile Heart has released the debut trailer, information, and screenshots for Villion: Code, its newly announced school RPG by Megami Tensei and Persona series co-creator Kouji Okada.

item.description: The Disney Afternoon Collection is coming to Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 with two new games.

item.title: The robot rhythm RPG, Steel Century Groove, is now available via Steam
item.description: "Solo indie developer Sloth Gloss Games is delighted to announce that their debut game, robot rhythm RPG, Steel Century Groove, is out now on Windows PC via Steam." - Sloth Gloss Games.

item.description: Senior Director and Video Game Industry Advisor at Circana Mat Piscatella on social media revealed the average household income for people buying video games in 2025.

item.title: DokeV: Vaporware or Vision? A Tense Conversation With a Pearl Abyss Developer
item.description: Is DokeV real? We sat down with a developer at Pearl Abyss who agreed to speak with us about the games long silence, the teams ambitions, and whether fans should still believe in DokeV.

item.title: PC Is by Far the Most Popular Platform for Developers, GDC Survey Shows
item.description: As is tradition, the Game Developers Conference has released the results of its annual survey on platform preferences among developers. Once again, PC stands out as the most popular platform.
